[EN] Your explorer's instincts have served you well, and you have followed the path less travelled.

Take a moment to enjoy the view, then share your thoughts with those who come after you.
[ES] Tus instintos de explorador te han servido bien y has seguido el camino menos transitado.

Tómate un momento para disfrutar de la vista y luego comparte tus pensamientos con los que vienen detrás de ti.
